atm9e.quest.steam.coke.title: Coke Oven
atm9e.quest.steam.coke.info: It is recommended to set up a few coke ovens early as the creosote produced will be useful come LV.
atm9e.quest.steam.multis.title: Steam Mutliblocks
atm9e.quest.steam.multis.info: Steam Multiblocks are superior in everway to their single block counter parts, offering 8 parallels and 75% steam usage.
atm9e.quest.steam.andesite.title: Andesite Alloy
atm9e.quest.steam.andesite.info: Andesite Alloy is a combination of andesite and zinc dust, but while zinc dust can be made with a mortar andesite dust requires a macerator. TIP: the steam forge hammer offers better yeilds for making andesite alloy at 3:2 instead of the 2:1 when crafing by hand.

atm9e.quest.steam.blast_furnace.title: Blast Furnace
atm9e.quest.steam.blast_furnace.info: All 3 blast furnaces work for making steel however the railcraft one is the fastest of the bunch.
atm9e.quest.steam.blast_furnace.info_two: You may have notice some of the blast furnaces need soul sand and nether bricks but nether access is locked behind steel, recipes have been added to make them before access to the nether. Nether Brick can be made by bulk haunting brick. Soul Sand can be made by placing bog earth in a blood altar.

atm9e.quest.steam.glass.title: Glass
atm9e.quest.steam.glass.info: Glass can be made by placing glass dust in an alloy smelter with a block mold. Glass dust is made by combining quartz sand dust and flint dust. P.S. you unlock better methods of making glass in LV
